essence: Writing the enemy's name smeared with feces constitutes the prescribed ritual act.
Body dust of the target taken from inside a funeral pyre is the required material.
Consecration by this mantra causes a spirit to quickly seize the target.
One should cause an offering of ghee together with vacā to be given to Īśāna.
Consecrating with the mantra leads to well-being.
